title: Fib testcases are erroring out on multi-asic chassis packet system
author: vperumal
body:
**Description**

Fib scripts are erroring out because fib utils are checking VoQ DB to collect system neighbors, inband intf and port channel info. https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/fixtures/fib_utils.py#L39. This fails on multi-asic chassis-packet system


        # Collect system neighbors, inband intf and port channel info to resolve ptf ports
        # for system neigh or lags.
>       voq_db = VoqDbCli(duthosts.supervisor_nodes[0])
E       IndexError: list index out of range

duthosts   = [<MultiAsicSonicHost> sfd-t2-lc2]
duts_cfg_facts = {'sfd-t2-lc2': [{'ACL_TABLE': {'DATAACL': {'policy_desc': u'DATAACL', 'ports': [u'PortChannel1049', u'PortChannel1050'...epalive': u'3', 'local_addr': u'10.0.0.168', ...}, ...}, 'CONSOLE_SWITCH': {'console_mgmt': {'enabled': u'no'}}, ...}]}
duts_mg_facts = {'sfd-t2-lc2': {'deployment_id': u'1', 'dhcp_servers': [], 'dhcpv6_servers': [], 'forced_mgmt_routes': [], ...}}
fib_info   = {}
timestamp  = '2022-01-16-02:56:22'

common/fixtures/fib_utils.py:39: IndexError

linkedPullRequests.title: [chassis] Enhance Fib and IP Decap test case
linkedPullRequests.author: abdosi
linkedPullRequests.body:
What I did:

1. Fixes: https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/4982
2. Enhance IP Decap test case for chassis.
3. Depends on https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/pull/5011


Following changes done:-
1. For T2 make VOQ Data fetch option using switch_type
2. Support router-mac per asic and make test case adapt to that using PTF Port map.
3. Fib Balancing test case take care for multi-dut if there single vs multiple routing hop.

How I verify:
